title: Interpretable prediction model for severe community-acquired pneumonia in adults: machine learning development and validation using routine laboratory parameters
summary: Six ML models predict progression to severe CAP using first-24h routine labs; temporal cohorts 1,051 development and 409 validation at same hospital. LightGBM AUC .893 train and .879 temporal validation, with calibrated Brier scores. Methods/Results read; temporal same-center retrospective validation limits generalization.
